about: Pre-registered tolerances for the Ask grader, committed before its first graded run (Oct 27, 2026). Each one is the precision of the measurement the answer rests on, or a design value marked as such; none is set from the Ask's answers. A miss is published as a miss; no tolerance is widened after a run (AGENTS.md: never loosen a check).

score_goals.why: A goal is a discrete event and the scorebug prints the score in digits (ninety/intel/scoring.py): a stated goal count is right or wrong, so the tolerance is exact.

goal_minute.why: Match minutes are said as floor(t/60)+1 (companion_match._minute_now) while the truth goal time is to the frame; a goal 2 s either side of a minute boundary reads as the neighbouring minute. One minute either way, no more.

count_edge_s.why: A count (passes, shots, on target, corners, out of play) is right when it lies between the true count over the window shrunk by 1.0 s at each end and the true count over the window grown by 1.0 s: the strict event-timing match of docs/EVALUATION.md (event_score, 'Passes (strict: 1.0 s, 1.0 m)'). No other slack: a missed or invented event is an error the fan sees.

share_points.why: Possession as time on the ball (#424, docs/eval/possession-time.json): measured MAE 5.75 points, largest error 8.1 points over six windows on seeds 8080 and 8324; the screen airs it as 'give or take 10 points'. A stated share within 10 points of the true share (time on the ball, dead ball excluded, ninety/eval/possession_time.py's truth) passes.

territory_points.why: Design, borrowed: territory is measured from the same tracked ball and the same possession spells as the share above, and has no measurement of its own on these clips yet; the share's 10 points is used until it does.

completion_points.why: Design, borrowed: completion is a share of detected passes; no completion error is measured (docs/EVALUATION.md has pass recall 0.54, precision 0.88, n=13, too few for a rate). The share's 10 points is used until it is.

leader_margin_points.why: A comparison ('who's on top', momentum) names the club the truth puts ahead on the intent's metric. When the true margin is within the metric's own tolerance (10 points, above) the truth cannot tell them apart, so 'even', either club, or a both-club comparison passes.

distance_pct.why: Team distance from tracked positions is aired as 'tracked, ±21%' (insights team_stats.within_pct, ninety/intel/team_stats.within_pct): its measured bound.

peak_speed_kmh.why: docs/EVALUATION.md, 'Tracked positions for the phone': median error of tracked top speed 1.5 km/h (ninety/eval/tracked_speed, M1 clip, 21 Oct).

player_rank_top.why: Design: a 'best', 'fastest' or 'furthest' answer passes when the player it names is in the truth's top 3 for the metric over the same scope. Peak speeds within 1.5 km/h and distances within 21% (above) cannot be ranked by the measurement, and involvement counts of the top players are within a few touches; 3 is fixed here before any run.

consistency.why: Design: paraphrases of one intent at one time pass when their lead sentences are the same after lower-casing and removing the question-specific club order; the modal headline is the reference.

comparison_direction.unit: club named first in the lead sentence
comparison_direction.why: Added Oct 27 on Kian's decision that detector-bound counts (shots, on target, passes, corners, out of play) lead with a club comparison; committed with its test before any answer was graded with it (the rest of this file is unchanged since 3766efbe). Passes when the answer's lead sentence names the club that truly has more over the footage shown, or says 'level' when the truth is level. The truth is ordered only where the clubs' count bands (count_edge_s above, the strict 1.0 s event timing) do not overlap; where they overlap, 'level' or the club ahead on the central count passes. Amended before any graded run (ask-intents, #432): level is also said as 'N each' or 'neither side has had'; completion said as a direction ('X have passed more accurately than Y') is checked the same way on the footage completion, level within completion_points (10).
